text: Sirkooɓe ɓen no rewude gaanin Alla sanamuuji Alla jippinaali hujja ka Deftere Makko fii rewugol ɗi, laatanaaki ɓe kadi dilil tippuɗo e ganndal fii ɗum, anndu tuugorde maɓɓe nden e ɗum ko munnagol ñemmba ngol baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, laatanaaki tooñooɓe ɓen ballo haɗanoowo ɓe ko jippotoo kon e maɓɓe immorde e lepte Alla.
